summary: Confirmed both requested estimates after reading the entire markdown conversion, including Appendices A-I and references, and extracting PDF pp. 5-8 and 14 with PyMuPDF. PDF p. 8, Table 3 prints the CP correlations with novelty (r = −0.30) and usefulness (r = 0.42), both marked ** (p < .01), and N = 198. Section 6.3.1 codes CP as elaboration = 1 and generation = 0; the novelty record correctly preserves the printed sign and documents its opposite orientation to the named treatment-minus-control contrast. The correlations pool both perceived-intelligence conditions. Phase-specific counts and arm-level outcome summaries are not printed and correctly remain null. The requested coding is supported: expert-rated novelty and usefulness, participant unit and uncertainty basis, immediate outcomes, between-subjects AI-design comparisons, and higher scores indicating greater creativity. outcome_with_ai = true and question = with_ai are supported by AI collaboration during production of the same advertising proposal, rather than a separate unassisted transfer task (Sections 6.1-6.2 and Appendix G). No eligible reported full-sample outcome or contrast is missing: Studies 2a and 2b have fewer than 50 people; self-reports, indirect effects, and moderation results are outside scope; no full-sample output contrast for randomized high versus low perceived intelligence is printed.
